attribution: EDGAR v8.1 air pollutant emissions, European Commission Joint Research Centre (JRC), https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ap81; values converted to WRF emission units and remapped to the model grid by ArWen.
provenance: Archives fetched over HTTPS from https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/EDGAR/datasets/v81_FT2022_AP_new/<SPECIES>/TOTALS/flx_nc/ on 2026-09-30, sha256 and size pinned above; each zip holds one NetCDF4 file with float32 fluxes(lat=1800, lon=3600) in kg m-2 s-1 on 0.1 deg cell centres (-89.95..89.95 N, -179.95..179.95 E) and a _readme.html. Annual 2022 totals, no seasonal, weekly or diurnal profile (a declared v1 simplification; the monthly sector files under .../monthly/ are the v2 route). remap bilinear on the flux density is not mass-exact; the conservative route is cell_sum on flux x cell area, named for v2. BC and OC go to the hydrophobic rows only, as WRF's emiss_opt=6 block does (chem/emissions_driver.F:1604-1607).
